input.quote: During the term of this Agreement, Company agrees to compensate Contractor as set forth in each Statement of Work. Contractor will be compensated on a time and materials.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no minimum purchase, volume, retainer or take-or-pay commitment on Clear Capital. Services are engaged "on a task by task basis" under individually agreed Statements of Work (p0004), compensation is on a time-and-materials basis as set out in each Statement of Work (p0013), and on termination Contractor is paid only fees and expenses "incurred or earned ... through the effective date of such termination" (p0033). Searches for minimum, shortfall, volume, guaranteed, retainer, non-cancelable and prepaid commitment language returned no responsive clause. This meets the preferred position (no minimum commitment; fees for ordered Services only), so no redline is warranted. We note only that Contractor may change rates on 30 days' notice (p0014), which is a pricing point outside this rule.
